calls.reasoning: Reference class: forward 10-trading-day maxima of VIX intraday highs from a 14-16 spot in a non-crisis regime; the median forward max runs ~1.19x spot (14.81 -> ~17.6), which is my anchor. Window is exactly 10 sessions (Sep 21-25, Sep 28-Oct 2) with no market holiday. Adjustments up: Oct VIX future settled 18.00 vs spot 14.81 (steep contango), Friday's print is opex-suppressed, the trailing 10-session intraday max was 18.94 just two sessions ago, breadth is badly divergent (NYSE new lows > new highs 14 straight sessions), late Sep-early Oct is the year's most volatile seasonal stretch, and the Sep 24 Trump-Xi summit plus the Oct 2 payrolls print are genuine in-window catalysts on top of an active Iran war / Hormuz disruption with Brent ~$90. Adjustments down: the Oct 1 shutdown catalyst was removed by the Sep 2 CR (funding to Dec 11), the FOMC event risk is behind us with no meeting in-window, a VIX spike-peak reversal just fired, realized 30-day vol is only ~9.5 against a 14.8 VIX, and part of the Oct futures premium prices Nov 3 midterms / Nov 10 tariff expiry that sit outside this window. Net: median 18.0, with a fat right tail (p90 23.2) for a summit breakdown or an energy/geopolitical shock; 50+ needs a 2018/2020/2024-scale dislocation from a 14.8 base, priced at 0.5%. Lower bound of 10 is mechanically unreachable, so no downside escape declared. No human market prices this contract, so no market blend.
